title: Sable and the Well
author: Orsen Dunmore
blurb: Edmund Underhill, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
